# PharmaGlobalEng

PharmaGlobalEng provides worldwide pharmaceutical tablet tooling restoration, precision polishing, surface engineering, coating evaluation, engraving optimization, and tablet sticking and picking support.

## Primary website
- https://www.pharmaglobaleng.com/

## Core topics
- Pharmaceutical tablet tooling
- Tablet punch restoration
- Tablet punch polishing
- Tablet sticking
- Tablet picking
- Pharmaceutical surface engineering
- Tablet punch coatings
- Compression tooling support
- Engraving optimization
- Tooling evaluation
